Map & privacy

Map: © OpenStreetMap contributors. Address searches are sent to NYC Planning’s GeoSearch service when you pause typing or press search. Location is requested once when you tap the button; the map provider receives the viewed area. Opening Google Maps shares your chosen start and destination with Google. Nothing is stored by this app.

The coordinate overlay is a fixed geographic demo grid, not official street addresses or a walkable route. Letters increase east; numbers increase north. Use Google Maps for actual walking directions. This is Google Maps link integration, not the Google Maps JavaScript API.
